title: And
html_source: Dixon poured Bloom a drink: everyone had a drink.

anchor.prefix: mountain. And they teach the serpents there to entwine themselves up on long sticks out of the ground and of the scales of these serpents they brew out a brewage like to mead.
anchor.suffix: the learning knight let pour for childe Leopold a draught and halp thereto the while all they that were there drank every each. And childe Leopold did up his beaver for to pleasur
